title: The Remembered Hand Primer
summary: A first primer for the memory-aligned on letting the hand repeat a form exactly as it was learned and on reading the touch of what others held.

title: A Handbook of Sharp Recollection
summary: A handbook that trains the memory-aligned to call back words and forms with no blur and to blur a foe's grasp of the last moment.

title: The Imprint Workbook
summary: A workbook of drills that press a pattern into the body until it can be repeated without thought and read back from what it touched.

title: Primer of Lingering Traces
summary: A primer on the faint traces that people and strikes leave in the air and on the ground and on following them back to their source.

title: The Keepsake Reader's Course
summary: A course in reading the warmth that clings to treasured objects and in drawing strength from remembered kindness.

title: A Beginner's Book of Retained Things
summary: A beginner's book on keeping every small detail of a fight and a face so that nothing observed is lost.
